meta.title: Accessibility statement — Cybercrime Report & Track
meta.description: What we're targeting, what's implemented, and what hasn't been independently verified yet.

title: Accessibility statement
subtitle: What we're building toward, what's actually implemented, and what we haven't independently verified yet. We'd rather tell you the honest, narrower truth than claim a conformance level we haven't tested.
targetBody: WCAG 2.1 Level AA, scoped to the journeys we've actually shipped — not the whole site, and not a claim we haven't walked ourselves. As of this page, that's:
targetScope: this page and the other honesty/help pages (/whats-real, /help/just-happened, /privacy)

implemented.title: The 1930 helpline is a real, always-visible tel: link
implemented.body: It sits in the page header on every screen and never scrolls away, with a real accessible name ("Call 1930"), not an image with no alt text.

implemented.title: A skip-to-content link is the first focusable element
implemented.body: Tab once on any page and you can jump straight past the header to the main content.

implemented.title: lang is set on the <html> element
implemented.body: It switches with the active locale — English or Hindi — so screen readers pronounce the page correctly.

implemented.title: Semantic structure and real landmarks
implemented.body: One <main> region, a labelled header, real <button> and <a> elements for anything clickable — built on shadcn/ui's Radix primitives, which give correct roles and keyboard behaviour by default.

implemented.title: Visible focus rings everywhere
implemented.body: Every interactive element uses focus-visible styling; outline: none is not used anywhere in this codebase.

implemented.title: No auto-advancing motion
implemented.body: There is no carousel, no auto-playing content, and no countdown timer anywhere in the product. prefers-reduced-motion is respected globally.

implemented.title: One viewport tag, zoom never disabled
implemented.body: Pinch-zoom and text scaling work normally on every page.

implemented.title: Labels are always visible
implemented.body: Form fields use real, persistent <label> elements — never a placeholder standing in for a label.

implemented.title: No minimum character counts
implemented.body: The incident narrative has no minimum length. A character counter, where shown, counts up to a maximum only.

notVerifiedTitle: What we have not verified yet
notVerifiedIntro: This is the part most conformance statements skip. Being honest about it is the point.

notVerified.strong: No automated accessibility pass (axe, Lighthouse) has been run on these pages yet.
notVerified.body: What's listed above reflects the code as written, not a test run and its results.

notVerified.strong: No screen-reader walkthrough has been done yet
notVerified.body: of the confirmation screen or the tel:1930 control specifically.

notVerified.strong: Colour contrast has not been independently measured
notVerified.body: against the shipped tokens in both light and dark mode, beyond being chosen with the 4.5:1 / 3:1 targets in mind.

notVerified.strong: We are not claiming full WCAG 2.1 AA conformance today.
notVerified.body: We're stating the target, what's built toward it, and what still needs a real test pass — which we intend to run and publish results for, including any failures, before treating this as a conformance claim.

footer: See <link>what's real vs mocked</link> for the rest of this prototype's honest scope.
